Name: Fenfeli's High Res Portraits
Author: FENFELIFRAN
Description:
Portrait mod for update 1.6 of the SDV base game.

[b][size=4]How to install:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Download the mods Portraiture and Content Patcher.
[*]Place said mods within your Stardew Valley mods folder.
[*]Place the Fenfeli Portraits mod within the portraits folder in Portraiture
[*]When playing the game, press 'p' to change between portrait mods when talking to an NPC.
[/list]
All mods need to be unzipped before they can be utilised. 


If any characters are missing from the mod, please inform me, and I'll make sure to rectify the mistake ^^

Downloads.Description:
Includes all NPC portraits in high resolution.

Changes:
Updated all portraits to a newer version
Fixed an issue with multiplicates in the files
Added Lantana from the mod Polyamorous Sweet

Please refer to the mod description for installation details.
